summary: A prepaid monthly VPS plan with one flat price per fixed size: Cloud VPS 4 is $6.60 a month on the 1-month term, there is no hourly meter, and a powered-off server keeps billing until the paid period ends.

egress.included: Unlimited inbound and outbound traffic on every Cloud VPS plan
egress.note: There is no per-GiB charge and no published traffic allowance. Contabo applies a fair-use policy and reserves the right to throttle servers with exceptionally high or disruptive usage; the port speed is 200 Mbit/s on Cloud VPS 4 and up to 1 Gbit/s on the largest plans. Not priced by the calculator.

plans.name: Monthly (1-month term)
plans.note: The card uses the 1-month term, the only monthly-billed option, at its ongoing price. The 3- and 6-month terms cost the same per month; 12 months is 15% cheaper and 24 months 20% cheaper, both paid upfront.

notes: Term choice: the card prices the 1-month term. Cloud VPS 4 is $6.60 a month on 1, 3 or 6 months, $5.28 a month on the 24-month term ($126.72 paid upfront for two years), and €5.50 (1–6 months) / €4.68 (12 months) / €4.40 (24 months) in the EUR list. The 24-month rate is the one Contabo advertises most prominently; the 1-month rate is the ongoing price a monthly buyer pays.
No setup fee was shown for any term in the configurator on 2026-10-30 ("No Setup Fee" under 1, 3, 6, 12 and 24 months). Contabo has advertised no VPS setup fee since 2014.

There is no hourly or per-second meter. A server is sold as a monthly plan, so a single ten-minute task costs a whole month, and tasks mode assumes all runs share one plan back to back. Running one fresh server per task would need one monthly plan per task.

A powered-off server keeps billing for the paid period: the contract is for a term, not for running time, and cancelling leaves the service active until the end of the current billing period. The card bills one monthly plan for workload C whether the server runs 90 hours or 730.

Cloud VPS 4 is 4 vCPU / 8 GB RAM / 100 GB SSD. The 4 vCPU and 8 GB are the smallest Core VPS allocation, so workload A (2 vCPU / 4 GiB) and workload C (2 vCPU / 4 GiB) are served by a larger shape. There is no custom CPU/RAM split.

Contabo labels RAM and disk in GB. The card maps 8 GB to 8 GiB, as the other VPS cards do. If 8 GB is decimal, it is 7.45 GiB and workload B's 8 GiB request is 0.55 GiB short; the next shape (Cloud VPS 6, 12 GB) would be needed. This is unresolved because Contabo does not say which unit it means.

Add-ons are separate monthly charges and are not in A/B/C: Auto Backup (€1.65/month on Cloud VPS 4 in the configurator), Private Networking (€2.29/month), one additional IPv4 (€3.50/month), 100 GB extra SSD (€1.50/month), Windows Server licence (€8.00/month). Those are net EUR prices from the configurator; the USD list is a fixed 1.2× the EUR list at this check.
Storage Extension adds capacity of the plan's own type, up to 1.2 TB on the top Core plan. It is tied to the server and is not a detachable volume, so it is not modelled as a volume.
GPU VPS (one NVIDIA RTX 6000 PRO configuration, EU and US Central) is a separate product and was showing a waitlist on 2026-10-30; it is not in this card.
Prices are Contabo's own USD list on the en-US site, excluding VAT. The account currency is fixed at order; EUR and GBP lists differ, and EU consumers pay VAT on top.
